title: Proof of topological mass formula algebraic
html:
Proof

The pre-\tau identity follows directly from the unified knot mass formula (thm:knot-mass-formula-unified) with three observations:

  1. Descended piece. The level-0 Markov trace |\mathrm{tr}_M(\rho(\beta))| is the Jones polynomial J_K(q) \in \mathbb{Z}[q^{\pm 1/2}] (thm:jones-markov-trace), an element of \mathbb{Q}(q).
  2. Singleton tower. Each \Phi_q(|\hat V_i|) is a quantum dilogarithm of an element of \mathbb{Z}[q^{1/2}, q^{-1/2}]; formally well-defined in the Habiro completion \widehat{\mathbb{Z}[q]} (def:habiro-ring) without analytic continuation.
  3. Pair tower. Each pair contribution \Phi_q(|\hat V_i \hat V_j|) is similarly in \widehat{\mathbb{Z}[q]}, with the z^2 prefactor established by lem:tower-pair-equality-fixed-level as an exact equality.

The full sum is therefore an element of \widehat{\mathbb{Z}[q]} \subset \mathbb{Q}(q) at every step. The \tau_{\mathrm{arch}} specialisation at q = q_0 then produces the canonical mass; multiplication by \hbar_q^{-2} and identification with \mathrm{Vol}(K) / \hbar_{q_0}^{2} via the volume conjecture is the τ-image step recorded by prop:topological-mass-formula. \square
